multi_operator_proposals.numerator: observed proposals touched by more than one operator

concurrent_mutation_attempts.numerator: mutation attempts whose execution windows overlapped for one proposal

short_name_conflicts.numerator: creation attempts blocked by an already observed active short name

index_conflicts.numerator: operations producing a stale or conflicting derived archive INDEX

worktree_isolation_runs.numerator: parallel runs using separate Git worktrees and proposal short names

recovery_interventions.numerator: incidents requiring a documented recovery action before work continued

workflow_bypass_observations.numerator: operations with observable direct managed-state mutation outside the CLI
